findings.title: Incidental unrequested wording tweak next to the required §7.2 rewrite
findings.detail: The task's §7.2 instruction is to rewrite the closing sentence ('It applies to the spec gate only…') so the round cap applies to both gates. The diff also silently changes 'and the round cap is' to 'and the round cap are' in the preceding, unrelated sentence (docs/.../.../design.md §3–§8 citation) — a change not called for by the task and not needed to satisfy any of the listed anchors/checks. Harmless, but it's an edit beyond the task's stated problem inside a file the task does govern precisely.
